rows.en: You betrayed me, Alien Pedan!
Ultra Garrison, sortie!
Give me a lab coat!
Dr. Dorothy Anderson!

The special metal the Alien Pedan use should be destructible with bullets made using Ryton R30!

Dr. Tsuchida… let's begin!
Yes…
This is our only round! If you miss, it's all over.

Frankly, this round's effectiveness is still an unknown quantity! Fire it from as close as you possibly can!

If this operation succeeds… Ryton R30 will go into mass production. Good luck.
Understood!
Damn… I-I blew it!
We did it!
Did we get it…?
Yes… I'm truly glad.

Mm…

But… we'll be busy from here on. The TDF Science Group's work is no picnic.
Yes… Let's do our best, for the sake of peace.
I'm counting on you both…
This is it, isn't it, [HERO4]… The war between the Naager and humanity is about to begin.
Are you really all right with this? Fighting the Naager means you'll truly be fighting your father…

From today on, I no longer think of my old man as my father!

My father is already gone from this world! And so am I…

The ones alive now are Steel Emperor Zephas and the Black Knight Lucifard! And my mission is to defeat him!

And… and once that's over…
…Once it's over?

With your own hands, I want you to…

I want you to kill me!

…Understood! I'll kill you, [HERO2]! With my own hands…

So until then, please don't die! Not until the day we defeat Steel Emperor Zephas…
Thank you, [HERO4]…
But really, what's going on? Coming up to Tokyo out of the blue like this…
Mm… The truth is, I saw it. That ship…
Saw it…? Where? Where did you see it? That footage…

At the TDF, of course…

My son… was a member of the TDF's Science Group, you see.
Eh…

It's all ancient history now…

More importantly, [HERO2]… please take care of that girl! She has no one left but you now…
Uh, sure…
I don't mind being hated… but I'd ask you not to hate my son. Not her father, who loved that girl more than anyone…
Oh… looks like the bus is here.
Well then, take care of yourself! You're not an ordinary person, after all… Upsy-daisy…
At last, the Earth Defense Conference began. The top item on the agenda, of course, was the Space Fortress Naager, steadily drawing closer to Earth even now.
At this stage, the TDF officially designated the Naager a hypothetical enemy. The scientific staff stayed on at the center and began searching for some means against the Naager…
U7… Come with me to the hangar.

The hangar?

But… Robo isn't there anymore! That hangar is full of memories…
Never mind that… Just come, quickly!
Ah…
Well? U7…
Branch Chief! What on earth is this!?

Mm…

It's a good thing we gave the great power, the Republic of Merca, our analysis data on Giant Robo…

Who'd have thought it would come in handy like this…
But who did it? Who repaired Robo?

Dr. Sahara…

I thought that if anyone could, it would be Dr. Sahara, the man who created Brain… And the result is a great success!

Dr. Sahara…?

Robo… I'll never make a mistake like that again! You'll forgive me, won't you? Robo…
Escort Dr. D. Anderson to the International Science Center!
Defeat all Brain Robots!
Defeat all Brain Robots and Kelbaan!
Defeat all Brain Robots, Kelbaan and Iron Mask Party robots!
Defeat all Brain Robots, Kelbaan and Iron Mask Party robots! Also, defeat the super robot with Ultraseven!
Defeat all Brain Robots, Iron Mask Party robots, Kelbaan and the super robot!
Defeat the Space Robot King Joe!
Furuhashi is defeated
<c3>Tsuyoshi Kaijo</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
<c3>Akira Shinmei</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Akira Shinmei</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
<c3>Kenji Asuka</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
<c3>Daita Oiwa</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
<c3>Peggy Matsuyama</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
To wipe out the Gorenger and EAGLE Base, Volcano Mask General Magman launched "Operation Roller" with the mobile fortress Navaron!
Blast it! Advance! Destroy! Leave not a single tree standing! Let not a single human live!
It's the Varidreen!

So they've come…

Right, today I'll show them what for! Send out the Kelbaan!

…!?

That's the Naager bunch, isn't it?

Curse you, Kelbaan! Let's give 'em a taste of this!

Ha haaa, how d'ya like that!

…Hm!? Shinmei, it's the Navaron!
Dive! Fire Sky Lock!
…!? They've installed a barrier!?
Heh heh heh… I'm not afraid of the Varidreen!
Like moths to the flame! Fire Road!
How does it feel, burning to death slowly? Hahaha…
Aka and the others are in danger! Let's go, Dai!
You bet! Varitank, move out!
Fire extinguisher, switch on!
The fire's out!? Thank you!
The Navaron has a barrier! We'll get close and attack from underground!
Nngh… Open fire! Crush the Varitank!
Gyro Screw, switch on!
Oh, blast! They've escaped underground!
Hoiiii! Hoiiii!
This is terrible! The Varitank is counterattacking!

uncertain: U10825/U10828: ライトンR－30 rendered "Ryton R30" to match the glossary Ryton R30 Bomb.
U10827: speaker is Kiriyama handing the round to Furuhashi (the shooter, per U10829-U10831).
U10836: Kiriyama's よろしくお願いします to the two scientists, "I'm counting on you both".
U10844-U10853: [HERO2] speaking with Seijiro; あの子 = [HERO4] (Seijiro's granddaughter, female); "that footage" in U10846 is the ship image shown at the TDF.
U10853: 皆通 read as 普通 "You're not an ordinary person"; U10852-U10853 are narration-kind continuations of Seijiro's speech.
U10874-U10879: system messages formatted like B0001 ("Morale went UP/DOWN"); 『』 around UP/DOWN dropped.
U10885/U10891: Daita's 新命どん and Akira's 大ちゃん rendered "Shinmei" and "Dai"; Daita's dialect softened to casual speech.
U10891: アカ = Akarenger (Tsuyoshi Kaijo), kept as the team nickname "Aka".

new_names.why: Giant Robo country, not in glossary
generic term for King Joe here
